sources.title: GitHub - Karthikgowda-web/HerbalHeal-AI
sources.snippet: HerbaScan is a high-performance, full-stack application designed to bridge the gap between ancient Ayurvedic knowledge and modern digital accessibility. Utilizing a custom-trained MobileNetV2 CNN model, it identifies over 40 species of medicinal plants with high precision and delivers trilingual (EN, HI, KN) traditional remedy intelligence.

sources.title: GitHub - Egabrielaladen/HerbaScan: AUTOMATIC RECOGNITION OF MEDICINAL ...
sources.snippet: # Purpose The app addresses the challenge of recognizing medicinal plants for respiratory diseases, particularly for individuals with limited knowledge of traditional remedies. By utilizing AI and machine learning, HerbaScan aims to bridge the gap between traditional practices and contemporary healthcare.
